module: Flowgraph node "Rally Stage Stars" (category once_instant, tags rally, mission, stars). Awards the bronze/silver/gold medals of an attempt by comparing its time (attempt.data.time) to the mission thresholds (missionTypeData.goldTime, silverTime, bronzeTime): attempt.unlockedStars.<threshold> = time <= threshold. Nothing is evaluated if the attempt is abandoned (dnf) or has no positive time. Input and output: attempt ('attemptData' table).

workOnce.desc: If the flow is active, updates the attempt's unlockedStars and returns it in the attempt output pin.
